items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
items.summary: Colette Kress will remain Nvidias chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

items.title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
items.summary: Bit Digitals $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

items.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
items.summary: Thailands SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

items.title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Arks Valente
items.summary: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARKs research director.

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.summary: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

items.title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis Form a New Crypto-Crime Task Force—Replacing One That Just Collapsed
items.summary: The Digital Crime Task Force aims to proactively trace illicit USDT on Tron and freeze funds before they move—just weeks after the trios near-identical T3 unit, built with rival firm TRM Labs, quietly collapsed.

items.title: Anchorage Digitals Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visas Network
items.summary: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Unions USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.

items.title: Tether Gold Gets Clean KPMG Audit Confirming $2.2B in Physical Gold Backing
items.summary: KPMG counted every gold bar behind XAUT, making it Tether's second stablecoin to complete a full audit by a Big Four accounting firm.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, With CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
items.summary: The Nvidia co-founder steps down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, ending his 33-year run.

items.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygons Payments Stack
items.summary: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
items.summary: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.

items.title: Exodus cost reset is real as payments offset crypto wallet slowdown, StoneX says
items.summary: Payments generated $10.9 million in Q3, while Exodus cut staff and restarted U.S. payment card issuance.

items.title: Visa adds Western Unions USDPT stablecoin to its settlement network in Anchorage tie-up
items.summary: Anchorage Digital and Visa will support select Anchorage-issued stablecoins as settlement assets on VisaNet, starting with USDPT.

items.title: Unocoin login suspension continues as exchange flags outgoing BitGo ETH transactions
items.summary: Indian crypto exchange Unocoin flagged outgoing BitGo ether transactions as a multi-day login suspension continues.

items.title: Tether Gold issuer follows USDT to complete Big Four audit
items.summary: KPMG U.S. gave Tether Gold issuer TG Commodities an unqualified, or clean, opinion on its 2025 financial accounts.

items.title: Andreessen Horowitz, DeFi Education Fund push back against Illinois crypto tax
items.summary: Crypto industry heavyweights are banding together to challenge Illinois over its controversial crypto tax.

items.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized securities to Solana in second half of 2027
items.summary: DTCC plans to add Solana to its tokenization service in the second half of 2027, alongside Canton and Besu.

items.title: Googles new AI reveals hidden genetic clues in new immune-cell test
items.summary: AlphaGenome 2 tailors predictions to cell types and states, with DeepMind reporting benchmark gains and reproduction of established disease biology.

items.title: Bitcoins spot-demand signal is improving. A bigger futures slump is drowning it out
items.summary: Both demand components remain negative, leaving Bitcoins tentative stabilization dependent on persistent spot improvement and easing futures weakness.

items.title: Bitcoin plunges to $71k as Jensen Huang abruptly resigns sending Nvidia into $2 trillion wipeout
items.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned Thursday, sending the chipmakers shares tumbling and intensifying a selloff across cryptocurrency markets.

items.title: Do not let Sauron have the ring: Voorhees warns against a government veto on AI
items.summary: His Sauron warning targets control over AI releases, a power already proposed in a September bill and El-Sayeds campaign platform.

items.title: Notion users put access keys in AI chats. A supplier breach exposed them
items.summary: The November 11 action shows why chats without ownership labels can still expose credentials embedded in messages.

items.title: Strategy spent more than twice as much on preferred-share buybacks as Bitcoin. Now comes its MSCI exit

items.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
items.summary: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

items.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
items.summary: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: The blockchain built to run financial markets
Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
items.summary: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

items.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
